ITEM 1 | Broccoli florets, bright green with darker green tips, clustered on the upper left of the plate, with thick pale green stems; surface appears slightly glossy and moist, florets roughly 2-4 cm across, holding their shape, some lightly browned edges | 85
ITEM 2 | Sliced radishes, thin rounds about 0.2 cm thick, bright red skin with white interiors, fanned in an overlapping arc on the left side of the plate, matte and firm | 25
ITEM 3 | Cherry tomatoes, whole and halved, glossy red skin, some with visible seeds, scattered in the center of the plate, smooth, juicy-looking, roughly 2-3 cm diameter each | 60
ITEM 4 | Red onion rings, pale purple-white layers, curled and stacked at the upper right near the fish, translucent edges, moist, soft-looking | 15
ITEM 5 | Fish fillet piece with dark charred or crisp grilled skin, deep brown-black on top, pinkish-orange flesh underneath, about 6 x 4 cm and roughly 2 cm thick, sitting on the upper right of the plate, slightly glossy | 90
ITEM 6 | Second fish fillet piece, salmon-pink flesh with golden-brown seared crust and flaky texture, about 7 x 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, with small green herb flecks on top, lying in the right center of the plate | 95
ITEM 7 | Small green herb leaves, dark green, a few flat leaves scattered on the fish fillet, very small amount | 2
ITEM 8 | Scattered small bits of minced garlic or herb pieces, pale golden-tan and irregular, a few tiny crumbs near the tomatoes and fish, dry-looking | 3
